verdict.rationale: Sill streams either a single Mac window or the whole desktop, and its bar shows window thumbnails described as "Every window, one tap away," which suggests switching windows during a session. An Apps list also lets you open any Mac app. Nothing in the evidence covers picking a specific monitor on a multi-display Mac, so only the window/app half of the story is shown. Missing for 10: choosing a specific monitor on a multi-display host, explicit documentation of switching between desktop and window views mid-session, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can view a specific monitor, window, or app on a multi-display host and switch between them mid-session

citations.quote: Sill shows a window from your Mac, or its whole desktop, on your iPhone or iPad
"Launch any Mac app." Sill's Apps list on an iPad held sideways, with a search field, the apps open now and every app installed on the Mac.
